Release notes

Ship on Friday without holding your breath

Every deploy now runs behind a health gate, so a bad build rolls itself back before anyone notices.

The gate watches error rate and latency for the first five minutes. If either drifts past its budget, traffic returns to the previous version and the team gets a short report instead of a page at midnight.

We stopped scheduling releases around who was on call.

4 min read · Updated 12 March
